scope.summary: BkSoftTissue integration test (spec 13.20 acceptance; OBR-001, REQ-028): archetype (a) petite + extreme-large perky natural breasts runs the full lane end to end - cage generation, autocolliders, gravity settle, jiggle impulse, deterministic repeat, prop squish, and firmness contrast - with Argus captures persisted as evidence.
acceptance_criteria: End-to-end: seed archetype (a) channel state, generate cages + autocolliders, gravity settle, apply a jiggle impulse, settle gate passes, and a repeated run is MeshComparator-equal.
Prop squish: a capsule prop pressed into the settled breast produces indentation with volume redistribution and full recovery on release; metrics asserted.
Firmness contrast: the same scenario at implant-firm settings produces measurably smaller motion amplitude than natural-soft.
Argus capture set (settled rest, max jiggle deflection, squish contact) persisted as evidence rows for validator and operator review.
scope.risk_if_missed: Without the archetype (a) end-to-end proof, BkSoftTissue ships as unproven components; petite + extreme breasts is the operator's signature body and the first place cage, collider, and firmness integration will break in production.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
